This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to correct the cause title.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with C.T. Case No.108 of 2023 arising out of Sahadevkhunta P.S. Case No.47 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M.,
Balasore for offences punishable under sections 420/376(2)(n)/ 354-C/506/507 of the Indian Penal Code.
The prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected by the learned Additional Sessions Judge -cum- // 2 // Presiding Officer, Designated Court, OPID, Balasore vide order dated 03.03.2023.

Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in judicial custody since February 2023 and the victim is aged about thirty years and there was marriage proposal between the petitioner and the victim and physical relationship between them on Uttam Kumar Bej vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98771113/
1 number of occasion and after going through the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim produced by the learned counsel for the State, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper.
Accordingly, the BLAPL is disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge RKM Uttam Kumar Bej vs State Of Odisha ....
